summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K on September 23, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing completion and quality release of a 5mg naturally derived psilocybin capsule batch produced at its cGMP Princeton, British Columbia facility under a Health Canada Drug Establishment Licence. The batch supplies a Health Canada-approved Phase 2 open-label MDD trial of up to 200 participants, with dosing expected complete by end-2027, and Australian Authorised Prescriber clinics for treatment-resistant depression. No transaction, price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are stated. This is a routine operational milestone disclosure, not a special situation; monitor trial enrollment and regulatory progress.
